visible_summary: A cropped email from Ingrid Halvorsen recaps a Tilbury depot cutover: the cutover moves to the night of the 4th; integrations keeps reconciliation for the first 48 hours before handback to regional planning on the morning of the 7th; June adjustments will not be re-run; the rollback decision still lacks an agreed single owner; and a final paragraph asks whether the old export format will continue during transition, but its concluding text is outside the crop.
